verdict.rationale: Crawl4AI's own docs describe adaptive crawling that uses information foraging algorithms to decide when enough information has been gathered to answer the query, then stops. That matches the story directly. The evidence is a single first-party announcement, with no detail on how sufficiency is judged or configured and no hands-on confirmation. Missing for 10: documentation of stopping criteria and configuration, independent or hands-on corroboration that it stops reliably.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can rely on adaptive crawling that automatically stops once enough information has been gathered to answer my query

citations.quote: Crawl4AI now features intelligent adaptive crawling that knows when to stop! Using advanced information foraging algorithms, it determines when sufficient information has been gathered to answer your query.
